rows.value: 15% of the annual tax base up to 36× the average wage (CZK 1,762,812 in 2026) and 23% above; taxpayer credit CZK 30,840 a year. rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A1; detailed table: income-tax
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 16 and 35ba
rows.label: Personal income tax (daň z příjmů fyzických osob) [national]
rows.value: 15% of the annual tax base up to 36× the average wage (CZK 1,762,812 in 2026) and 23% above; taxpayer credit CZK 30,840 a year. Paid by residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Czech-source income (employees through monthly advances withheld by the employer). Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 16, 35ba and 38h.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A5
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 4
rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (taxed as income) [national]
rows.value: Gains are taxed as income at 15% / 23%; exempt after holding securities or crypto-assets for 3 years (crypto: exemption lost on the part of exempt proceeds above CZK 40 million a year) and real estate for 10 years (own housing: 2 years). Paid by individuals selling assets. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. § 4 (1) (a), (b), (u), (zk) and § 4 (3).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 36
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (srážková daň) [national]
rows.value: 15% on dividends and profit shares (residents and non-residents), on bond and deposit-certificate yields of resident individuals, and on interest and royalties paid to non-residents; 35% for residents of non-EU/EEA countries with no tax treaty or information exchange agreement; 5% on financial lease payments to non-residents. Paid by the recipient (withheld by the Czech payer). Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. § 36.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A7
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 4 and 9
rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: Rental income is taxed on the 15% / 23% scale after actual expenses or a flat 30% (at most CZK 600,000 a year); regular pensions are exempt up to 36× the minimum wage valid on 1 January (CZK 806,400 in 2026). Paid by individuals receiving rent or pensions. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. § 9 (4) and § 4 (1) (h).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 2, 22, 35ba and 38h
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (daňový nerezident) [national]
rows.value: Pay for work done in Czechia is taxed on the normal 15% / 23% scale through the employer's monthly advances; the taxpayer credit is allowed, other credits and allowances only for EU/EEA residents with at least 90% of their income from Czech sources; residence test: home or 183 days in the year. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 2, 22, 35ba (2) and 38h.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B1; detailed table: social-employee
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 589/1992 Sb., o pojistném na sociální zabezpečení a příspěvku na státní politiku zaměstnanosti, consolidated version in force from 1 November 2026, § 7 odst. 1
rows.label: Social insurance contributions (pojistné na sociální zabezpečení) and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Employee 7.1% (pension 6.5%, sickness 0.6%) and employer 24.8% (pension 21.5%, sickness 2.1%, employment policy 1.2%) up to 48× the average wage (CZK 2,350,416 a year); health insurance 13.5% (employee 4.5%, employer 9%) with no ceiling. Paid by employees and employers. Zákon č. 589/1992 Sb. § 7; zákon č. 592/1992 Sb. § 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B2; detailed table: employer-levies
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 435/2004 Sb., o zaměstnanosti, consolidated version in force from 1 July 2026, §§ 81 and 82
rows.label: Employer levies: disability employment quota levy (odvod do státního rozpočtu) [national]
rows.value: Employers with more than 25 employees must employ 4% people with disabilities; for each missing person the levy is the average national wage (Q1 to Q3) × 1, 2 or 3.5 depending on the share actually employed. Paid by employers with more than 25 employees. Zákon č. 435/2004 Sb. §§ 81 and 82.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B3; detailed table: osvc-contributions
rows.source_title: ČSSZ: Změna výše minimálních záloh OSVČ v roce 2026
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (OSVČ): pension and health insurance [national]
rows.value: Pension insurance 29.2% and health insurance 13.5%, each on 50% of the profit; minimum monthly advances from July 2026: CZK 5,005 pension (main activity) and CZK 3,306 health. Paid by self-employed persons (OSVČ). Zákon č. 589/1992 Sb. § 14; zákon č. 592/1992 Sb. § 3a.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 262/2006 Sb., zákoník práce, consolidated version in force from 1 November 2026, § 2
rows.label: Contractor rules: the dependent-work test and withholding on payments to non-resident contractors [national]
rows.value: Work with the features of dependent work must be done under an employment contract or a DPP/DPČ agreement, otherwise it is illegal work (fine for the business up to CZK 10 million); no withholding on resident self-employed contractors; 15% final withholding on services and professional work done in Czechia by non-residents (35% non-treaty), 10% security withholding on other Czech payments to non-EU/EEA residents. Paid by clients and contractors. Zákon č. 262/2006 Sb. §§ 2 and 3; zákon č. 435/2004 Sb. §§ 5 and 140; zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 36 and 38e.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 21
rows.label: Corporate income tax (daň z příjmů právnických osob) [national]
rows.value: 21% (5% basic investment funds, 0% pension funds); 15% global minimum tax (dorovnávací daň) for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750 million; the 60% windfall profits tax applied to 2023 to 2025 only. Paid by companies and other legal persons. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 20ba and 21; zákon č. 416/2023 Sb..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C2
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 634/2004 Sb., o správních poplatcích, consolidated version in force from 1 September 2026, tariff item 24
rows.label: Trade licence fee (local business licence, ohlášení živnosti) [national]
rows.value: CZK 1,000 to notify a first trade (CZK 500 for each further trade), paid to the trade licensing office. Paid by sole traders and companies starting a licensed trade. Zákon č. 634/2004 Sb., tariff item 24.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C3; detailed table: pausalni-dan
rows.source_title: Finanční správa: Informace k institutu paušální daně pro rok 2025 a 2026
rows.label: Simplified regimes: paušální daň (lump-sum tax) and flat-rate expenses [national]
rows.value: One monthly payment covering income tax, pension and health insurance: CZK 9,162 (band 1), 16,745 (band 2) or 27,139 (band 3) in 2026, for previous-year income up to CZK 2 million; or flat-rate expenses of 80%, 60%, 40% or 30% of income. Paid by self-employed persons who opt in. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 2a and 7 (7).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 22 and 36
rows.label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
rows.value: 15% withholding on dividends and other profit shares (35% for non-EU/EEA residents with no tax treaty or information exchange agreement); branches pay the 21% corporate rate on the income of the Czech permanent establishment. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company); foreign companies with a Czech branch. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 22 (1) (a) and 36.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 235/2004 Sb., o dani z přidané hodnoty, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2026, § 6 and § 47
rows.label: Value added tax (daň z přidané hodnoty, DPH) [national]
rows.value: 21% standard and 12% reduced rate; registration from turnover above CZK 2,000,000 in a calendar year (immediately above CZK 2,536,500). Paid by consumers (charged by VAT payers). Zákon č. 235/2004 Sb. §§ 6 and 47.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 353/2003 Sb., o spotřebních daních, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2026
rows.label: Excise duties (spotřební daně) [national]
rows.value: Petrol CZK 12,840 and diesel CZK 9,950 per 1,000 litres; spirits CZK 41,050 per hl of alcohol; beer CZK 32 per hl and degree Plato; still wine nil; cigarettes 30% of the retail price plus CZK 2.39 a cigarette (at least CZK 4.66); e-liquids CZK 7.5 per ml. Paid by producers and importers (passed on in prices). Zákon č. 353/2003 Sb. §§ 48, 70, 85, 96, 104 and 130u.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: excise
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 261/2007 Sb., o stabilizaci veřejných rozpočtů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2025, parts 45 to 47
rows.label: Energy taxes on electricity, natural gas and solid fuels [national]
rows.value: Electricity CZK 28.30 per MWh; natural gas CZK 30.60 per MWh for heating (CZK 264.80 as motor fuel); solid fuels CZK 8.50 per GJ. Paid by suppliers (passed on to final consumers). Zákon č. 261/2007 Sb., parts 45 to 47.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 187/2016 Sb., o dani z hazardních her, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2024 (still in force on 22 November 2026), § 1 to 6 and annex
rows.label: Gambling tax (daň z hazardních her) [national]
rows.value: 35% of gross gaming revenue (stakes less winnings paid) on lotteries, technical games and unlicensed gambling; 30% on odds betting, totalisator games, bingo, live games, raffles and small tournaments; minimum tax on other technical games CZK 13,400 per gaming position each quarter. Paid by licensed or notified gambling operators. Zákon č. 187/2016 Sb., o dani z hazardních her, § 1 to 6 and annex.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 338/1992 Sb., o dani z nemovitých věcí, consolidated version in force from 1 October 2025
rows.label: Property tax (daň z nemovitých věcí) [national and municipal]
rows.value: Land: 1.35% or 0.45% of the price of farm and forest land, or CZK 0.08 to 9 per m²; buildings and flats: CZK 3.50 to 18 per m²; residential rates and building plots × 1.0 to 4.5 by municipality size, all × an inflation coefficient and a municipal local coefficient of 0.5 to 5.0. Paid by owners of land, buildings and units. Zákon č. 338/1992 Sb. §§ 6, 11, 11f and 12.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer
rows.source_title: Finanční správa: Daň z nabytí nemovitých věcí
rows.label: Real estate transfer tax (daň z nabytí nemovitých věcí) [national]
rows.value: None: abolished for acquisitions registered from 26 September 2020; the land register fee is CZK 2,000. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 386/2020 Sb..

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, §§ 4a and 10
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax: none as a separate tax; income tax on some gifts [national]
rows.value: Inheritances are exempt from income tax; gifts from close relatives and household members are exempt, occasional gifts from others up to CZK 50,000 per donor a year; other gifts are taxed as income (individuals 15% / 23%). Paid by recipients of taxable gifts. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. §§ 4a and 10.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F1
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 16/1993 Sb., o dani silniční, consolidated version in force from 1 July 2025, § 2
rows.label: Road tax (daň silniční): vehicle tax on lorries; vehicle registration fee [national]
rows.value: Annual road tax only on lorries of categories N2 and N3 and their O3/O4 trailers registered in Czechia, by axles, maximum weight and suspension (annex to the Act); registering a car costs CZK 800 (administrative fee). Paid by owners or operators of lorries; vehicle registrants. Zákon č. 16/1993 Sb. § 2; zákon č. 634/2004 Sb., tariff item 26.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 565/1990 Sb., o místních poplatcích, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2025
rows.label: Tourist fee (poplatek z pobytu) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by each municipality by ordinance, at most CZK 50 per day of stay (the day of arrival is not counted). Paid by guests (collected by the accommodation provider). Zákon č. 565/1990 Sb. §§ 1, 3c and 3d.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: EUR-Lex: Council Regulation (EU) 2026/382 of 11 February 2026
rows.label: Customs duty, import VAT and travel allowances [EU and national]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff on the customs value; the EUR 150 duty relief ended on 1 July 2026 (EUR 3 per item for IOSS and postal consignments until 1 July 2028); import VAT at 21% / 12%; travellers EUR 300 (land) or EUR 430 (air and sea), 200 cigarettes, 1 litre of spirits; cash of EUR 10,000 or more must be declared. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulation (EU) 2026/382; Directive 2007/74/EC; Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 634/2004 Sb., o správních poplatcích, consolidated version in force from 1 September 2026
rows.label: Administrative fees (správní poplatky) [national]
rows.value: Fixed fees per official act set in the tariff of the Act, for example CZK 2,000 for a land register application, CZK 800 to register a car and CZK 1,000 for a first trade licence. Paid by people and businesses requesting the act. Zákon č. 634/2004 Sb. (tariff items 24, 26 and 120).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 348/2005 Sb., o rozhlasových a televizních poplatcích, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2026
rows.label: Radio and television licence fees (rozhlasové a televizní poplatky) [national]
rows.value: CZK 55 a month (radio) and CZK 150 a month (television). Paid by households and businesses with a receiver (paid to Český rozhlas and Česká televize). Zákon č. 348/2005 Sb. § 6.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 565/1990 Sb., o místních poplatcích, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2025
rows.label: Municipal fees: waste fee and dog fee (místní poplatky) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by municipal ordinance: municipal waste system fee up to CZK 1,200 a year per person; dog fee up to CZK 1,500 a year per dog (CZK 200 for owners over 65). Paid by residents and dog owners. Zákon č. 565/1990 Sb. §§ 2 and 10h.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item H3; detailed table: freelancers
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 2
rows.label: Expat and new residents: no inbound regime; Digital Nomad programme [national]
rows.value: No reduced rate or exemption for new residents: residents (home or 183 days) pay the normal rates on worldwide income; Digital Nomad programme for IT and marketing specialists (see the freelancers section). Paid by new residents. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb. § 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A2
rows.source_title: Finanční správa (Generální finanční ředitelství): Informace k inkasu daně z příjmů fyzických osob (43/24), information provided under Act No. 106/1999 Sb.
rows.label: Surcharge on income tax: none (solidarity increase abolished) (solidární zvýšení daně) [national]
rows.value: None since 2021: the 7% solidarity increase of 2013 to 2020 was replaced by the 23% rate on the part of the tax base above the threshold. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, § 16.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A3
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 243/2000 Sb., o rozpočtovém určení daní, consolidated version in force from 29 August 2026, §§ 1, 3 and 4
rows.label: Regional or municipal income tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: regions (kraje) and municipalities levy no income tax; they receive shares of the national income tax yield (regions 10.23% and municipalities 25.93% of the tax on employment income, municipalities a further 1.5%). Paid by no one. Zákon č. 243/2000 Sb., o rozpočtovém určení daní, §§ 3 and 4.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item A4
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 428/2012 Sb., o majetkovém vyrovnání s církvemi a náboženskými společnostmi, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2020, §§ 15 and 17
rows.label: Church tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: churches are financed by the state, through the settlement compensation paid in 30 annual instalments from 2013 and a state contribution during a 17-year transitional period. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 428/2012 Sb., §§ 15 and 17.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item B4
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 376/2015 Sb., o ukončení důchodového spoření, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2018, §§ 1 and 10
rows.label: Occupational pension or funded pension savings: none (důchodové spoření) [national]
rows.value: None: the funded pension savings scheme (důchodové spoření) was ended by Act No. 376/2015 Sb.; pension fund licences expired on 30 June 2016. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 376/2015 Sb., o ukončení důchodového spoření.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 243/2000 Sb., o rozpočtovém určení daní, consolidated version in force from 29 August 2026, §§ 1, 3 and 4
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: VAT and excise duties are national taxes; regions receive 10.23% and municipalities 25.93% of the national VAT yield. Paid by no one. Zákon č. 243/2000 Sb., o rozpočtovém určení daní, §§ 1, 3 and 4.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: Finanční správa: Daňový systém ČR – Popis systému (legal position on 1 January 2026)
rows.label: Digital services, insurance premium and financial transaction taxes: none [national]
rows.value: None: no such tax is among the direct and indirect taxes described by the Financial Administration (legal position on 1 January 2026); financial and insurance services are exempt from VAT without input-tax deduction. Paid by no one. Finanční správa, Daňový systém ČR.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item E3
rows.source_title: Finanční správa: Daňový systém ČR – Popis systému (legal position on 1 January 2026)
rows.label: Wealth tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: the direct taxes are the income taxes, the real estate tax, the road tax and the gambling tax; there is no net wealth tax. Paid by no one. Finanční správa, Daňový systém ČR.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F2
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 201/2012 Sb., o ochraně ovzduší, consolidated version in force from 1 January 2026, § 15 and annex 9
rows.label: Environmental charge: air pollution fee (poplatek za znečišťování ovzduší) [national]
rows.value: From 2025 per tonne emitted: particulate matter CZK 19,500, SO2 CZK 6,500, NOx CZK 5,200 and VOC CZK 13,000, times an emission-level coefficient of 0 to 1; exempt where a plant's fees total less than CZK 50,000. Paid by operators of the stationary sources listed in annex 2. Zákon č. 201/2012 Sb., o ochraně ovzduší, § 15 and annex 9.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Czechia: the full list
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: Finanční správa: Daňový systém ČR – Popis systému (legal position on 1 January 2026)
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax: none [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax is among the taxes described by the Financial Administration. Paid by no one. Finanční správa, Daňový systém ČR.
